svg.text: Definitions disagree for sleep, insomnia and epilepsy; never for ADHD or autism
Cochran's Q across all definitions of one condition, with the full jackknife covariance
where Q falls if the definitions made no difference
the p-value: the tail beyond the observed Q
observed Q, p of 0.05 or more
observed Q, p < 0.05, in the trait's colour
Sleep apnoea: definitions disagree for 4 of 5 traits; insomnia 4 of 5; constipation 2 of 5.
Epilepsy: 3 of 5 (bipolar, depression, PTSD). ADHD: 0 of 5.
Autism: definitions disagree for 0 of the 5 conditions.
